pull_request.title: Infrastructure: account PR133 through PR151 interactions and work
pull_request.head: codex/pr133-151-accounting
pull_request.body:
Account for PR133 through PR151 without double-counting shared sessions, copied run receipts or reused simulated samples. The report and compact JSON retain immutable source references and explicit gaps.

- 56 user chat inputs across 51 user-initiated turns, plus 3 public GitHub request inputs.
- At least 1,067,294,375 observed tokens across 168 unique measured turns; 1,048,581,504 input tokens were cached. Four closed historical observations are now accounted once, preserving original owners where present.
- At least 67 transport attempts: 63 successful, 4 failed; 201,805 event executions in successful jobs. Nine initialization probes are separate. The 59 timed transport attempts total 5 h 22 min process wall and 43.83 CPU-hours.

See logs/usage/AUDIT-2026-11-19-pr133-151.md and its JSON companion for PR groups, individual jobs, production times and counting definitions. PR152 onward and current audit consumption are excluded. Missing historical counters, deleted/partial run evidence and eight control durations remain unknown; these are lower bounds, not billing or elapsed project time.

Validation: 305 paired sessions, 130 PR ledgers, project records (111 tasks/54 documents/24 reviews), canonical token validation and preview build, independent arithmetic and fresh verification of 136 existing observations, whitespace checks. No new simulations or detector changes. Infrastructure accounting only; no design sign-off or merge requested.
